title: Bangla Text Dataset and Exploratory Analysis for Online Harassment Detection
reasoning: The paper creates and analyzes a dataset for online harassment that includes 'religious' as one of the five primary categories for labeling comments. The analysis breaks down the number of comments in this category (7,577 comments, 17.22% of the dataset) and examines its distribution across victim genders and professions. This constitutes a direct evaluation and categorization of religious-themed content as a form of online harassment, which falls under the scope of evaluating faith/religion-related topics.
